evidence.composition_near_identical: eval and test are both 100% year>=2025, 100% conv_prefix=='feat', pos_rate .9442 vs .9497, changed_files median 2 vs 2. evidence.tfidf_scores_HIGHER_on_test: class-weighted TF-IDF on the identical splits: canonical-train .6796 eval / .7883 test; regime-train .6754 / .7913; big-train .6489 / .6415
evidence.conclusion: if the test half carried less signal, the bag-of-words and the size feature would drop there too. Both rise. The dense-only eval-over-test gap (+.087 big-train, +.052 regime, +.097 canonical) is therefore the checkpoint-selection optimism this cell's own history already flagged (~.035 in the 2026-06 run), enlarged by how unstable these runs are.

instability.reading: three seeds of the same recipe on the same rows agree with each other only r=.35-.67 in predicted probability. They are not estimating one function; the seed mean is an average over materially different models.

per_area_test.reading: on the one test area with enough rows to read, the fine-tuned 8B reader is AT CHANCE (mean .517 big-train, .491 regime) while a linear bag-of-words on the identical rows reaches .63-.78.

bank_comparison.caveat: the Layer-1 bank numbers are computed on the cell's own label-STRATIFIED split of the 7,956-row canonical slice, not on these AREA-GROUPED folds. They are a reference point, NOT an apples-to-apples comparison, and no Delta_beyond should be differenced against them from this run.

implied_delta_beyond: NOT COMPUTABLE. Delta_beyond = T - VA_nl requires an honest T; the dense arm does not supply one here. What can be said on the area-grouped folds is that a class-weighted linear TF-IDF reaches .788 test where the dense reader reaches .550 -- the ceiling this cell has is lexical, and the dense instrument does not reach it.

label_semantics_bound.note: the train fold re-admits rows the de-confounding audit removed, including 1,635 'abandoned' rejects where y=0 records the author walking away rather than a reviewer decision. Because every evaluated row is canonical and the areas are disjoint, nothing confounded leaks into the readout; the cost is a train->eval shift. The regime-matched arm was run precisely to bound that shift and came out LOWER than big-train on both halves, so the shift is not what is holding the dense arm down.
